en: Nyeeeh... I'm sleepy...

I couldn't sleep well last night... It took 
all my courage just to use the bathroom...

But I guess people can overcome their
fears when they're really forced to...
<CLT=cltMIND>So she was holding it in...
Kaede! Say something to her!
Huh? What's going on?

Angie is trying to brainwash me and Himiko
with her Atua nonsense!

Brainwash? I'm just answering Himiko's
questions about Atua...

Wha-Wha-Wha!? Are you saying...Himiko...of
all people...
...believes in Atua over magic!?
<CLT=cltMIND>Well...both are hard to believe.
I don't believe in him...

It's just...strange to me that Angie isn't 
afraid of tomorrow's time limit...

Nyahaha! Because Atua has already
welcomed me into His kingdom!

Shaddup about Atua! Your god's not gonna
get us out of this situation!
Huh? You don't believe, Tenko?
The only thing I believe in is Aikido!
Hmmm, I see. What about you, Himiko?

I'm a mage...
I don't need to learn any priest spells.

I see, I see!
Well, I suppose that's okay for now.

Atua is a merciful god. He forgives everyone,
even those who do not believe.

And the nonbelievers always come around
eventually...

Cuz Atua is always with me!
Nyahahaha! How divine!

Why, you...! I will not be deceived by your
words!
Nor will Himiko, either!

Um...believing in Atua sounds like 
too much of a pain...
<CLT=cltMIND>That's your reason?

Himiko! You should believe in Aikido over
Atua!
That's a pain too...

By the way, about our talk yesterday... Let me
know if there's anything I can do to help!

Good morning, good morning to you both!
Spending time together again?
